thread:
maria: Quick flag — we're seeing schema validation rejections for function/tool outputs in prod. ~0.8% of calls over the last 10m. Looks related to tools returning extra metadata keys (e.g. confidence_score) that our strict schema currently rejects.

alex: ugh, that explains the surge in fallback routing to the smaller model and the latency spike. any sample logs?

maria: pasted one example (trimmed):
```json
{"tool": "search_snippets", "result": [{"id": "123", "text": "..."}], "confidence_score": 0.92}
```

jon: does the validator run pre-routing or post-routing? if pre-routing, it could force fallback before we even try a compatible variant.

maria: pre-routing in the current flow — we validate structured output against the pinned schema before selecting a model variant. intent was to avoid passing bad payloads downstream, but it's causing aggressive fallbacks.

irene: we also lost some telemetry tags because the validation error path doesn't emit the normal model tags. so cost/latency attribution is wrong for those requests.

alex: two immediate options: 1) relax schema to allow extra properties (additionalProperties: true) for tool outputs; 2) move validation to after routing and only mark the tool response as failed (and do fallback after we know model variant). Pros/cons?

jon: (1) is quick but masks buggy tools. (2) is more correct: route to intended variant first, then validate; if invalid, fallback and emit detailed telemetry. Might be more involved change to the router.

maria: we also need better console surface: right now ops just see a bunch of fallback traces with no link to the validation reason. can we bubble the schema error into the per-route dashboard and show the offending payload snippet?

console-bot: per-console-policy, any changes that expose request payloads must be sanitized. Suggest showing a redacted snippet + error code + link to secure logs.

irene: telemetry plan: add an enum tag `validation_outcome` with values {ok, invalid_schema, validation_error, not_run} and a `validation_error_code` field. ensure these are emitted on both success/fallback paths.

alex: implementation plan proposal:
- short term (hotfix, <24h): allow additionalProperties for tool responses in the runtime validator and emit `validation_outcome=invalid_schema` for mismatches. route change = none.
- medium term (2w): rework routing so validation runs as a post-model step; on invalid, trigger controlled fallback and maintain attribution.
- long term: add console UX to show schema diff and redacted payload with link to secure logs + runbook.

jon: agree. also add unit tests covering tools that add metadata fields; and an e2e test exercising fallback attribution so we don't regress.

maria: I can ship the hotfix today. Will open a PR to relax validator and add telemetry tag. tagging @alex for review and @irene for the telemetry bits.

alex: reviewing this afternoon. one small ask: include a feature flag so we can toggle relaxed schema per-customer — some enterprises may want strict rejection.

maria: good call. feature flag named `tools.allow_extra_fields` with default true for hosted, but toggleable for Dedicated/Private.

irene: I'll update metrics schema and dashboards to include `validation_outcome`. Can we create a small alert: if invalid_schema rate > 0.5% for 5m then page oncall?

maria: yes, make that alert w/ runbook link. adding ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8521 (will add details).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: PR #7341 (validator: allow extra props + telemetry tag) — will run canary on prod shard us-west-2 for 15m.

alex: once canary is green, enable feature flag for hosted only. please include migration notes for Dedicated/Private customers.

jon: follow-up: can we add a small schema-lint tool for tool authors in devex so they catch extra fields locally? reduces prod incidents.

maria: agreed — I'll coordinate with devex. OK, rolling canary now. will post back results. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks. appreciate the quick cycle.

maria: canary passed. invalid_schema rate fell to 0.02% and fallback count normalized. closing loop: PR merged, feature flag on for hosted, jira updated.

irene: dashboards updated and alert set. leaving the ticket open for routing refactor.

jon: leaving a note: once routing refactor lands, we should consider switching default behavior to post-validation routing for better signal.

maria: noted. thanks everyone.
